Anyone can cut footage together. The job is making someone stay.

I'm Ravi Yadav, a video editor based in India with 4+ years in the content and advertising space — short-form that stops the scroll, and long-form that holds attention to the last frame.

I trained under Aevy TV's Video Mastery Cohort, one of India's most respected editing programs, and have since worked through agencies with clients I genuinely enjoyed cutting for.

I've built social content and ad campaigns for Appreciate Wealth, edited high-conversion ads for Sula Vineyards — including SulaFest campaigns that sold out for the first time in the event's history — and produced short- and long-form video for Kotak Neo across Instagram and YouTube.

Sharp cuts. Clean storytelling. Content that performs.
